description: One supplier's public facts on Paisán by id: category, location, summary, what it makes, industries served, number of products and profile link. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

id.description: The supplier id from a search result.

name: get_supplier
